Blocks.Text: The Organizational Page Content Analytics DMA API provides:

Single Post Analytics (SPA) demographics breakdown, including impressions, reactions, comments, reposts, and clicks.
SPA reactions count breakdown by reaction types (e.g. Like, maybe, etc.)
Demographics filter supported for the SPA breakdowns.
Support for trend data such as Organization level trend data and post level trend data.
List of people who reacted, commented, reposted and viewed the post.
The service provides the following methods:

Finder postDimension returns a list of OrganizationalPageContentAnalytics for a post. The list will be a dimension breakdown under the requested dimension type.
Finder trend returns a list of OrganizationalPageContentAnalytics for an organizational page or a post. The list will be a time series breakdown with the requested time range.
Finder postGestures returns a list of OrganizationalPageContentAnalytics for a post. Each returned record represents a post gesture performed by a member.
We are taking the following measures to protect member privacy and limit backtracking of analytics data.

Analytics values that are lower than a specific threshold determined by the server will be returned as 0 instead.
If the same exact request is sent twice, slightly different results might be returned due to the randomization factor added by the server to the actual analytics value.
We enforce API rate limits in order to protect member identity. Once the quota is fully used, results with analytics value equal to 0 will be returned with metadata indicating the quota refresh time.
If the actual analytics value is very close to the server set threshold, the added randomization factor might put it below the threshold for some requests hence results with analytics value equal to 0 will be returned.

How to determine which organizational pages you can query:
To find the organizational pages you can query analytics for, please use OrganizationAuthorization’s BATCH_FIND by AuthorizationAction and AuthenticatedMember with an authorization action of OrganizationAnalyticsAuthorizationActionType.UPDATE_ANALYTICS_READ.
